# Written by torii apply from the machine file. Do not edit: the next
# apply replaces it. Hand-written policy belongs in other files.

# Inbound: the proxy qube calls into the workload, on listed ports only.
qubes.ConnectTCP  +443  sys-torii  torii-probe  allow
qubes.ConnectTCP  +8080  sys-torii  torii-probe  allow
qubes.ConnectTCP  +8080  sys-torii  torii-probe2  allow

# Outbound: workloads that declare outbound access call their proxy qube.
torii.Connect  +socks  torii-probe2  @default  allow target=sys-torii
torii.Connect  +socks  torii-probe2  sys-torii  allow
torii.Connect  +http  torii-probe2  @default  allow target=sys-torii
torii.Connect  +http  torii-probe2  sys-torii  allow
torii.Connect  +f.db  torii-probe2  @default  allow target=sys-torii
torii.Connect  +f.db  torii-probe2  sys-torii  allow

# local-inbound: qubes on this machine, by port.
qubes.ConnectTCP  +22  torii-probe2  personal  allow

# dom0 and the named admin qubes read status and the decision log.
torii.Status  *  dom0  sys-torii  allow user=root

# Everything else is denied by 59-torii-deny.policy, after every mesh's file.
